analysis.insight_summary: The user would like to map a 0-10V analog input using only the 4-7V range to a scaled 0-10V analog output, with values below or above the selected input range getting clamped at the output extremes. The user is inquiring if this can be set up easily, likely hoping for a straightforward or built-in method. Another user has provided a suggestion, which was received positively.
